'''Zalar Rishek''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] of the [[House of Rishek]] family who lived during the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] following the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Around [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]], Rishek attended the maiden journey of a [[Gem of Alderaan|luxury hovertrain]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. During the excursion, Rishek [[Gambling/Legends|played]] a game of [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] and had an altercation with the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Musician/Legends|musician]] [[Khyyynett]].

==Biography==
Zalar Rishek was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] of the [[House of Rishek]] family who lived during the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] following the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="Gem of Alderaan" /> Around [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Echoes of the Jedi]],'' the fourth instalment of the ''[[Dawn of Defiance]]'' campaign, states that the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Vhiin Thorla]] traveled to the [[Almas Academy]] two [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the declaration of [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]], which is dated to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. This thus indicates that ''Dawn of Defiance'' is set in circa [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]].</ref> when Rishek was still a young man, he was among just over one hundred members of the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] elite invited to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] for the maiden voyage of the luxury [[Hovertrain/Legends|hovertrain]] ''[[Gem of Alderaan]]''. Rishek attended a lavish launch gala held at a [[Train station/Legends|hoverstation]]<ref name="Gem of Alderaan" /> in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Aldera/Legends|Aldera]]<ref name="Primer">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/dodcampaign|text=''Dawn of Defiance'': Gamemaster Primer}}</ref> and traveled on the [[Train/Legends|train]] as it departed on a six [[Standard hour/Legends|hour]] journey.<ref name="Gem of Alderaan" />

{{RPG|''[[The Gem of Alderaan]]''}}
During the excursion, Rishek visited the train's [[Casino/Legends|casino]] car and played the card game [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] with several other guests including the [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] executive [[Dien Suub]] and the [[Actor/Legends|actress]] [[Ardia Terrsyn]], bringing 4,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] to bankroll his [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]]. Accompanied by an entourage of hangers-on, Rishek also ventured to the hovertrain's [[Decadence nightclub]], where he had an altercation with the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Musician/Legends|musician]] [[Khyyynett]] while his entourage watched on. However, a group of undercover [[Alderaanian Resistance]] agents broke up the scuffle and separated the pair.<ref name="Gem of Alderaan" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
Rishek had [[Color/Legends|blond]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]] and blue [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. He was spoiled, conceited and overbearing and he liked to spend his [[Time/Legends|time]] either chasing potential romantic prospects or racing fast vehicles including customized [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeders]], [[Swoop/Legends|swoops]] and [[Yacht/Legends|yachts]].<ref name="Gem of Alderaan" />

==Behind the scenes==
Zalar Rishek appeared in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] roleplaying adventure ''[[The Gem of Alderaan]]'' by [[Gary M. Sarli]], which was published on [[Wizards.com]] on [[February 5]] [[2009]] as the eight instalment of [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Dawn of Defiance]]'' roleplaying campaign. In the adventure, the players roleplay as Alderaanian Resistance agents that infiltrate the ''Gem of Alderaan'' and seek the favor of Rishek and the other major guests so as to gain the attention of the train's patron [[Lady/Legends|Lady]] [[Alya Aldrete]]. It is possible for the players to join Rishek and other guests in a game of a sabacc, and Rishek's esteem for the operatives increases if they succeed at defeating him or the other participants. When Rishek engages in a heated quarrel with the Wookiee Khyyynett, it is possible for player characters to separate the pair in which case they improve Rishek's opinion of them; if the players are unsuccessful at breaking up the fracas or do not intervene then the quarrel escalates into a brawl.<ref name="Gem of Alderaan" />
